chapterTitle: Principle 8: Intuition: Dig deep before building up

support.text: Principle 8: Intuition: Dig deep before building up
Intuition emphasizes understanding deeply before stacking more knowledge.

safeExtensions: Shallow understanding can distort later layers of learning.
Deeper grasp changes what new information rests on.
Depth should reconnect to the real skill rather than float free of it.
prohibitedDrift: anti-practice rhetoric detached from the skill
